Chrome on the box is already signed into Google Cloud project argon-bulwark-491118-j2 (also shown as cursor-write).

Check and enable these two APIs if they are not already enabled:
1. Google Chat API (chat.googleapis.com)
2. Google Chat MCP API (chatmcp.googleapis.com)

Use these URLs directly:
- https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/chat.googleapis.com?project=argon-bulwark-491118-j2
- https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/chatmcp.googleapis.com?project=argon-bulwark-491118-j2

If an Enable button is present, click it and wait until it shows enabled/manage. If already enabled, do not disable anything.

Also open https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/api/chat.googleapis.com/hangouts-chat?project=argon-bulwark-491118-j2 (Chat API Configuration) and report whether a Chat app is configured (app name, interactive features). Do not change the Chat app config unless the page blocks enablement with a required field you can fill with: App name `Chat MCP`, avatar `https://developers.google.com/chat/images/quickstart-app-avatar.png`, description `Chat MCP server`.

Do not touch Google Chat messages. Do not create or delete OAuth clients.

Return: enabled status of both APIs, and whether a Chat app is configured.
I'll start with the first API page.

Both APIs already enabled; config form is blank (no changes made).

Results for project argon-bulwark-491118-j2 (cursor-write):

1. **Google Chat API (chat.googleapis.com)** — already **Enabled** (library page showed "API Enabled" with Manage; details page Status: Enabled). No Enable button present, nothing changed.
2. **Chat MCP API (chatmcp.googleapis.com)** — already **Enabled** ("API Enabled" + Manage). Nothing changed.

3. **Chat API Configuration (hangouts-chat page)** — **No Chat app is configured.** The form loads with:
   - Project number (App ID): 58089599401
   - App name: empty, Avatar URL: empty, Description: empty
   - "Build this Chat app as a Workspace add-on" checkbox: checked (default)
   - **Enable Interactive features: unchecked** — so no functionality (DM / join spaces both unchecked), no connection settings, no triggers, no commands, no link previews
   - Trigger endpoint fields all just "https://" placeholders; Visibility empty; "Log errors to Logging" checked
   - Save/Cancel present, nothing saved

Nothing blocked enablement, so I did not fill in the App name / avatar / description values. No Chat messages touched, no OAuth clients created or deleted. Note: one initial page load failed ("Failed to load") and succeeded on Retry.
